children: Biofrontera received FDA approval for Ameluz topical gel with RhodoLED red-light PDT to treat superficial basal cell carcinoma in adults.
FDA approved supplemental NDA for Ameluz 10% with BF-RhodoLED for treatment of superficial BCC in adults.
Ameluz becomes the first and only FDA-approved photodynamic therapy in the U.S. to treat a skin cancer.
Phase 3 trial (187 adults) showed 66% composite clinical and histological complete response vs 5% for placebo-PDT.
Label expansion leverages same topical product and device, enabling rapid adoption by existing customers and installed base.
Company plans official launch of the sBCC indication late Q4 2026 through Q1 2027 using current commercial organization.
